x: By the end of the first 4 km lap, with conditions under foot atrocious, Birhan was looking as strong as any of the others around her in the leading bunch - but it was a telling second circuit and the Aldershot duo of Emily Adams and Susie Bush both got the better of the Belgrave woman.
